description: A personal reference library with original observations, not an objective ranking or official endorsement.

references.name: 29CM
references.observation: Bold category navigation above large, varied campaign photographs.
references.avoid: Do not bring commerce navigation density into a simple service page.
references.limitations: One desktop state; mobile behavior, interaction quality, performance and conversion outcomes not audited.

references.name: Anthropic
references.observation: A strong left-aligned headline balanced by a quieter explanatory column.
references.avoid: Do not assume its typefaces or brand vocabulary fit your content.
references.limitations: One desktop state; mobile behavior, interaction quality, performance and conversion outcomes not audited.

references.name: Arc / Dia
references.observation: A vivid blue frame and soft color field introduce a prominent product preview.
references.avoid: The current page promotes Dia; do not describe the capture as the old Arc homepage.
references.limitations: One desktop state; mobile behavior, interaction quality, performance and conversion outcomes not audited.

references.name: Basement Studio
references.observation: A monochrome wireframe scene establishes an immersive technical identity.
references.avoid: A static frame does not validate the performance or accessibility of the 3D experience.
references.limitations: One desktop state; mobile behavior, interaction quality, performance and conversion outcomes not audited.

references.name: Clerk
references.observation: A centered, large value proposition sits above a clear developer-oriented action.
references.avoid: Do not copy the install command visible in the source screenshot.
references.limitations: One desktop state; mobile behavior, interaction quality, performance and conversion outcomes not audited.

references.name: Cursor
references.observation: A concise left-aligned pitch leads directly into a large product demonstration.
references.avoid: Use your own product imagery, not the reference screenshot as an asset.
references.limitations: One desktop state; mobile behavior, interaction quality, performance and conversion outcomes not audited.

references.name: Darkroom
references.observation: Oversized condensed red type contrasts sharply with a black canvas.
references.suitable_for: Opinionated studios and high-impact campaign pages
references.avoid: The dense display style may not suit long-form reading or multilingual copy.
references.limitations: One desktop state; mobile behavior, interaction quality, performance and conversion outcomes not audited.

references.name: Family
references.observation: Colorful characters frame a simple central headline and two distinct actions.
references.avoid: Commission or generate original artwork instead of copying the characters.
references.limitations: One desktop state; mobile behavior, interaction quality, performance and conversion outcomes not audited.

references.name: Fora
references.observation: An airy sky backdrop and travel imagery support a calm, centered introduction.
references.avoid: The paired actions fit two audiences; use one if your product has one main audience.
references.limitations: One desktop state; mobile behavior, interaction quality, performance and conversion outcomes not audited.

references.name: Illoca
references.observation: Grid-paper texture, small handwritten annotations, and cobalt illustration create a coherent identity.
references.suitable_for: Creative tools and visually distinctive products
references.avoid: The screenshot includes a cookie notice; it is not part of the recommended layout.
references.limitations: One desktop state; mobile behavior, interaction quality, performance and conversion outcomes not audited.

references.name: Linear
references.observation: Large restrained typography and a dark product surface create a focused software presentation.
references.avoid: Dark styling alone is not the design principle; preserve hierarchy and readable contrast.
references.limitations: One desktop state; mobile behavior, interaction quality, performance and conversion outcomes not audited.

references.name: Mobbin MCP
references.observation: A minimal navigation pill and oversized centered headline make the offering immediately legible.
references.suitable_for: Focused product launches and single-purpose tools
references.avoid: Do not inherit its claims or scale metrics.
references.limitations: One desktop state; mobile behavior, interaction quality, performance and conversion outcomes not audited.

references.name: resend
references.reason: Authenticated redirect or account-related state detected; no current screenshot published.

references.name: Rive
references.observation: A compact type-led hero separates developer and editor entry points.
references.suitable_for: Technical products with multiple entry paths
references.avoid: The command in the screenshot is source content, not an instruction to execute.
references.limitations: One desktop state; mobile behavior, interaction quality, performance and conversion outcomes not audited.

references.name: stripe
references.reason: Authenticated redirect or account-related state detected; no current screenshot published.

references.name: Teenage Engineering
references.observation: Dense graphic navigation and oversized campaign lettering give the page a distinctive editorial voice.
references.avoid: Do not reuse the illustration or reproduce the same complex navigation without a need.
references.limitations: One desktop state; mobile behavior, interaction quality, performance and conversion outcomes not audited.

references.name: Toss
references.observation: A large lifestyle image carries a short, high-contrast statement.
references.avoid: This new capture is the English locale; the older Korean capture remains in the archive.
references.limitations: One desktop state; mobile behavior, interaction quality, performance and conversion outcomes not audited.

references.name: Vercel
references.observation: Sparse dark composition balances a large statement, geometric focal point, and short supporting text.
references.avoid: A branded geometric mark must be replaced by an original visual.
references.limitations: One desktop state; mobile behavior, interaction quality, performance and conversion outcomes not audited.

references.name: Direct
references.observation: A split hero pairs a vivid conceptual object with oversized black typography.
references.avoid: Preserve the split hierarchy, not the reference artwork.
references.limitations: One desktop state; mobile behavior, interaction quality, performance and conversion outcomes not audited.

references.name: Aesop
references.observation: Immersive product imagery supports a short headline and a clearly bounded call to action.
references.avoid: Use your own images; verify text contrast across every video frame if using motion.
references.limitations: One desktop state; mobile behavior, interaction quality, performance and conversion outcomes not audited.
